verdict.rationale: The evidence never says which transcription models Fellow uses, gives no measured accuracy figures or benchmarks, and lists no known limits such as languages, accents or audio conditions. The only quality statement is the marketing phrase "human-level accuracy" (fellow-docs-51), which is the kind of unsubstantiated claim the story wants replaced. Feature mentions like diarized, timestamped transcripts describe transcript output, not how transcription works or how well it performs.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
